q: True or false: The DOH-PTC is a prerequisite for the License to Operate.
n: Build right first, then operate. Remember this: "15-1-365-10": HFSRB decides in 15 working days, the PTC is valid 1 year, work must start within 365 days, and appeals are filed within 10 days.

q: Fill in the blank: Applications are acted on within ___ working days.

o: PTC validity after approval in months
Time to begin construction before the PTC lapses

q: True or false: A second review after correction requires a new fee.
n: The second review is free; only a re-application after it pays again.
